ctx.x: You see. I remember an incident, man, there was a John Hicks--no, not John Hicks, John--what that boy's name--piano player--excellent piano player from Philadelphia, man. He lived in California--that John--what's his name--this guy can play, man, play piano. But Stan Getz, he ah, he couldn't stand nobody getting no bigger applause than he--
